```json
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# Research: Kids Activities Class Management Platform"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "## Decision 1: Frontend architecture uses Next.js App Router + Tailwind tokens"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "**Decision**: Keep a single Next.js App Router app with Tailwind CSS utility classes and"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "brand tokens in &#96;app/globals.css&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "**Rationale**: Matches current repository shape, reduces overhead, and supports both marketing"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "and authenticated organization experiences in one deployable unit."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "**Alternatives considered**:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "- Split frontend/backend into separate repos (rejected: higher complexity for MVP)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "- CSS-in-JS token system (rejected: unnecessary abstraction for initial scope)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "## Decision 2: Supabase as initial backend system of record"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "**Decision**: Use Supabase Postgres with migration-first schema changes and Supabase Auth for"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "user identity; derive org membership/roles from app tables."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "**Rationale**: Fastest path to robust auth + database with RLS support and local dev tooling."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "**Alternatives considered**:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "- Self-hosted Postgres + custom auth (rejected: slower to ship and higher security burden)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "- Firebase-only backend (rejected: relational policy model less natural for this domain)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "## Decision 3: Multi-tenant routing by globally unique org slug"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "**Decision**: Tenant context is resolved from &#96;/o/{orgSlug}&#96; routes and validated against"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "guardian/staff memberships on each protected request."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "**Rationale**: Clear dedicated organization URL model and predictable guardrail for tenant"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "isolation."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "**Alternatives considered**:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "- Tenant selection post-login only (rejected: conflicts with dedicated URL requirement)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "- Subdomain-per-org for MVP (rejected: DNS and environment complexity)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "## Decision 4: Role template model for staff permissions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "**Decision**: Keep base roles (&#96;owner&#96;, &#96;admin&#96;, &#96;instructor&#96;, &#96;coach&#96;) and add limited"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "admin-managed capability toggles for &#96;admin&#96; and &#96;instructor/coach&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "**Rationale**: Satisfies configurable permissions requirement while avoiding full ACL matrix"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "complexity."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "**Alternatives considered**:"
          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# Contracts: Kids Activities Class Management Platform"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "This file defines MVP API contracts to keep frontend and backend aligned."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "## Base assumptions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "- All protected routes require authenticated user context."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "- Tenant context is derived from URL slug (&#96;/o/{orgSlug}&#96;) and verified against membership."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "- JSON request/response format."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "## Endpoints"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "### Organizations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "- &#96;POST /api/organizations&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "  - Create organization with globally unique slug."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "  - Creates owner membership for current user."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "### Staff permissions and invites"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "- &#96;GET /api/o/{orgSlug}/role-templates&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "- &#96;PATCH /api/o/{orgSlug}/role-templates/{role}&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "  - Update limited capability toggles for &#96;admin&#96; or &#96;instructor/coach&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "- &#96;POST /api/o/{orgSlug}/invites&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "  - Invite staff with role &#96;admin|instructor|coach&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "### Guardian onboarding"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "- &#96;POST /api/o/{orgSlug}/guardians/join&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "  - Link current guardian user to organization membership."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "### Child profiles"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "- &#96;POST /api/o/{orgSlug}/children&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "  - Accepts &#96;firstName&#96;, &#96;birthDate&#96;, optional &#96;confirmDuplicate&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "  - If potential duplicate exists and &#96;confirmDuplicate&#96; is false/missing, return warning."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "### Enrollment policy"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "- &#96;GET /api/o/{orgSlug}/enrollment-policy&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "- &#96;PATCH /api/o/{orgSlug}/enrollment-policy&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "  - Set org-wide max concurrent activities per child."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "### Activities and enrollments"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "- &#96;GET /api/o/{orgSlug}/activities?eligibleForChildId={id}&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "- &#96;POST /api/o/{orgSlug}/enrollments&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "  - Enforces policy limit and activity eligibility."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "## Error contract (minimum)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "- &#96;403_forbidden_tenant_access&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "- &#96;404_organization_not_found&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "- &#96;409_slug_conflict&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "- &#96;409_duplicate_child_confirmation_required&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "- &#96;409_enrollment_limit_reached&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57,
            "text": "- &#96;422_validation_error&#96;"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 57
          },
          "startPosition": {}
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./specs/001-kids-activities-platform/contracts/README.md",
        "signatures": {}
      },

      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# [PROJECT_NAME] Constitution"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Spec Constitution, TaskFlow Constitution, etc. --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "## Core Principles"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "### [PRINCIPLE_1_NAME]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: I. Library-First --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "[PRINCIPLE_1_DESCRIPTION]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Every feature starts as a standalone library; Libraries must be self-contained, independently testable, documented; Clear purpose required - no organizational-only libraries --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "### [PRINCIPLE_2_NAME]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: II. CLI Interface --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "[PRINCIPLE_2_DESCRIPTION]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Every library exposes functionality via CLI; Text in/out protocol: stdin/args → stdout, errors → stderr; Support JSON + human-readable formats --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "### [PRINCIPLE_3_NAME]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: III. Test-First (NON-NEGOTIABLE) --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "[PRINCIPLE_3_DESCRIPTION]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: TDD mandatory: Tests written → User approved → Tests fail → Then implement; Red-Green-Refactor cycle strictly enforced --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "### [PRINCIPLE_4_NAME]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: IV. Integration Testing --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "[PRINCIPLE_4_DESCRIPTION]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Focus areas requiring integration tests: New library contract tests, Contract changes, Inter-service communication, Shared schemas --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "### [PRINCIPLE_5_NAME]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: V. Observability, VI. Versioning \u0026 Breaking Changes, VII. Simplicity --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "[PRINCIPLE_5_DESCRIPTION]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Text I/O ensures debuggability; Structured logging required; Or: MAJOR.MINOR.BUILD format; Or: Start simple, YAGNI principles --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "## [SECTION_2_NAME]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Additional Constraints, Security Requirements, Performance Standards, etc. --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "[SECTION_2_CONTENT]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Technology stack requirements, compliance standards, deployment policies, etc. --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "## [SECTION_3_NAME]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Development Workflow, Review Process, Quality Gates, etc. --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "[SECTION_3_CONTENT]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Code review requirements, testing gates, deployment approval process, etc. --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "## Governance"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: Constitution supersedes all other practices; Amendments require documentation, approval, migration plan --\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "[GOVERNANCE_RULES]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47,
            "text": "\u003c!-- Example: All PRs/reviews must verify compliance; Complexity must be justified; Use [GUIDANCE_FILE] for runtime development guidance --\u003e"
          }

            "text": "**Input**: Design documents from &#96;/specs/001-kids-activities-platform/&#96;  "

            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "**Checkpoint**: Local app boots with brand token baseline and env guidance."
          },

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "## Phase 2: Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "**Purpose**: Core tenancy, auth, RBAC, API scaffolding, and schema baseline used by all stories."

          },

          {

          },
          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# Feature Specification: Kids Activities Class Management Platform"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "**Feature Branch**: &#96;001-kids-activities-platform&#96;  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "**Created**: 2026-03-31  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "**Status**: Draft  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "**Input**: User description from &#96;.specstory/history/2026-03-30_23-48-58Z-clean-code-practices-and-guidelines.md&#96; lines 475-485"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "## Clarifications"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "### Session 2026-03-31"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "- Q: How should admin-configurable staff permissions work for MVP? → A: Role templates with limited customization by admin."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "- Q: How should dedicated organization sign-in URLs be structured? → A: Slug-based URL with globally unique organization slug."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "- Q: How should child enrollment activity limits be defined? → A: Organization-configured org-wide limit per child."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "- Q: Can a guardian account belong to multiple organizations? → A: Yes, one guardian account can belong to multiple organizations."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "- Q: How should duplicate child profiles be handled? → A: Warn on potential duplicate and require explicit confirmation."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "## User Scenarios \u0026 Testing *(mandatory)*"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "### User Story 1 - Organization setup and staff management (Priority: P1)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "As an organization owner, I can create an organization and invite staff so the"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "organization can operate classes with role-based access."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "**Why this priority**: No classes can be created or managed until organization ownership"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "and core staff permissions exist."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "**Independent Test**: Create an organization, invite admin/instructor/coach users, and"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "verify each role can access only allowed management screens/actions."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "**Acceptance Scenarios**:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "1. **Given** an authenticated owner, **When** they create an organization, **Then** the"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "   system stores the organization and marks that user as owner."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "2. **Given** an owner or admin, **When** they invite staff as admin/instructor/coach,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "   **Then** invited users are assigned role-based permissions after accepting invite."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "### User Story 2 - Guardian and child registration via org URL (Priority: P1)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "As a parent/guardian, I can register through an organization-specific sign-in URL and add"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43,
            "text": "my child profile so I can browse and enroll in activities."
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 44
          },
          "startPosition": {}
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./specs/001-kids-activities-platform/spec.md",
        "signatures": {}
      },
      "score": 0.16703279316425323

          {
            "lineNumber": 165,
            "text": "## Dependencies \u0026 Execution Order"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167,
            "text": "### Phase Dependencies"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169,
            "text": "- **Setup (Phase 1)**: No dependencies - can start immediately"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170,
            "text": "- **Foundational (Phase 2)**: Depends on Setup completion - BLOCKS all user stories"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171,
            "text": "- **User Stories (Phase 3+)**: All depend on Foundational phase completion"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172,
            "text": "  - User stories can then proceed in parallel (if staffed)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173,
            "text": "  - Or sequentially in priority order (P1 → P2 → P3)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174,
            "text": "- **Polish (Final Phase)**: Depends on all desired user stories being complete"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176,
            "text": "### User Story Dependencies"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178,
            "text": "- **User Story 1 (P1)**: Can start after Foundational (Phase 2) - No dependencies on other stories"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179,
            "text": "- **User Story 2 (P2)**: Can start after Foundational (Phase 2) - May integrate with US1 but should be independently testable"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180,
            "text": "- **User Story 3 (P3)**: Can start after Foundational (Phase 2) - May integrate with US1/US2 but should be independently testable"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182,
            "text": "### Within Each User Story"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184,
            "text": "- Tests (if included) MUST be written and FAIL before implementation"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185,
            "text": "- Models before services"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186,
            "text": "- Services before endpoints"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187,
            "text": "- Core implementation before integration"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188,
            "text": "- Story complete before moving to next priority"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190,
            "text": "### Parallel Opportunities"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 192,
            "text": "- All Setup tasks marked [P] can run in parallel"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193,
            "text": "- All Foundational tasks marked [P] can run in parallel (within Phase 2)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194,
            "text": "- Once Foundational phase completes, all user stories can start in parallel (if team capacity allows)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195,
            "text": "- All tests for a user story marked [P] can run in parallel"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196,
            "text": "- Models within a story marked [P] can run in parallel"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197,
            "text": "- Different user stories can be worked on in parallel by different team members"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 201,
            "text": "## Parallel Example: User Story 1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {

            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"

      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "description: Create or update the project constitution from interactive or provided principle inputs, ensuring all dependent templates stay in sync."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "handoffs: "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "  - label: Build Specification"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "    agent: speckit.specify"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "    prompt: Implement the feature specification based on the updated constitution. I want to build..."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "## User Input"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;text"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "$ARGUMENTS"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "You **MUST** consider the user input before proceeding (if not empty)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "## Outline"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "You are updating the project constitution at &#96;.specify/memory/constitution.md&#96;. This file is a TEMPLATE containing placeholder tokens in square brackets (e.g. &#96;[PROJECT_NAME]&#96;, &#96;[PRINCIPLE_1_NAME]&#96;). Your job is to (a) collect/derive concrete values, (b) fill the template precisely, and (c) propagate any amendments across dependent artifacts."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "**Note**: If &#96;.specify/memory/constitution.md&#96; does not exist yet, it should have been initialized from &#96;.specify/templates/constitution-template.md&#96; during project setup. If it's missing, copy the template first."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "Follow this execution flow:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "1. Load the existing constitution at &#96;.specify/memory/constitution.md&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "   - Identify every placeholder token of the form &#96;[ALL_CAPS_IDENTIFIER]&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "   **IMPORTANT**: The user might require less or more principles than the ones used in the template. If a number is specified, respect that - follow the general template. You will update the doc accordingly."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "2. Collect/derive values for placeholders:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "   - If user input (conversation) supplies a value, use it."
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 30
          },
          "startPosition": {}
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/commands/speckit.constitution.md",
        "signatures": {}
      },
      "score": 0.158341646194458

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 251,
            "text": "json_escape() {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 252,
            "text": "    local s=\"$1\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 253,
            "text": "    s=\"${s//\\\\/\\\\\\\\}\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 254,
            "text": "    s=\"${s//\\\"/\\\\\\\"}\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 255,
            "text": "    s=\"${s//$'\\n'/\\\\n}\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 256,
            "text": "    s=\"${s//$'\\t'/\\\\t}\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 257,
            "text": "    s=\"${s//$'\\r'/\\\\r}\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 258,
            "text": "    s=\"${s//$'\\b'/\\\\b}\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 259,
            "text": "    s=\"${s//$'\\f'/\\\\f}\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 260,
            "text": "    # Escape any remaining U+0001-U+001F control characters as \\uXXXX."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 261,
            "text": "    # (U+0000/NUL cannot appear in bash strings and is excluded.)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 262,
            "text": "    # LC_ALL=C ensures ${#s} counts bytes and ${s:$i:1} yields single bytes,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 263,
            "text": "    # so multi-byte UTF-8 sequences (first byte \u003e= 0xC0) pass through intact."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 264,
            "text": "    local LC_ALL=C"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 265,
            "text": "    local i char code"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 266,
            "text": "    for (( i=0; i\u003c${#s}; i++ )); do"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 267,
            "text": "        char=\"${s:$i:1}\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 268,
            "text": "        printf -v code '%d' \"'$char\" 2\u003e/dev/null || code=256"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 269,
            "text": "        if (( code \u003e= 1 \u0026\u0026 code \u003c= 31 )); then"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 270,
            "text": "            printf '\\\\u%04x' \"$code\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 271,
            "text": "        else"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 272,
            "text": "            printf '%s' \"$char\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 273,
            "text": "        fi"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 274,
            "text": "    done"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 275,
            "text": "}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 277,
            "text": "check_file() { [[ -f \"$1\" ]] \u0026\u0026 echo \"  ✓ $2\" || echo \"  ✗ $2\"; }"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 278,
            "text": "check_dir() { [[ -d \"$1\" \u0026\u0026 -n $(ls -A \"$1\" 2\u003e/dev/null) ]] \u0026\u0026 echo \"  ✓ $2\" || echo \"  ✗ $2\"; }"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 280,
            "text": "# Resolve a template name to a file path using the priority stack:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 281,
            "text": "#   1. .specify/templates/overrides/"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 282,
            "text": "#   2. .specify/presets/\u003cpreset-id\u003e/templates/ (sorted by priority from .registry)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 283,
            "text": "#   3. .specify/extensions/\u003cext-id\u003e/templates/"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 284,
            "text": "#   4. .specify/templates/ (core)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 285,
            "text": "resolve_template() {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 286,
            "text": "    local template_name=\"$1\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 287,
            "text": "    local repo_root=\"$2\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 288,
            "text": "    local base=\"$repo_root/.specify/templates\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 290,
            "text": "    # Priority 1: Project overrides"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 291,
            "text": "    local override=\"$base/overrides/${template_name}.md\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 292,
            "text": "    [ -f \"$override\" ] \u0026\u0026 echo \"$override\" \u0026\u0026 return 0"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 293
          },
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 250
          }
        },
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.specify/scripts/bash/common.sh",
        "signatures": {}
      },
      "score": 0.15522783994674683

            "text": "# Implementation Plan: [FEATURE]"

          },
          {

            "text": "**Branch**: &#96;[###-feature-name]&#96; | **Date**: [DATE] | **Spec**: [link]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "**Input**: Feature specification from &#96;/specs/[###-feature-name]/spec.md&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "**Note**: This template is filled in by the &#96;/speckit.plan&#96; command. See &#96;.specify/templates/plan-template.md&#96; for the execution workflow."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "## Summary"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "[Extract from feature spec: primary requirement + technical approach from research]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {

            "text": "## Technical Context"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "\u003c!--"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "  ACTION REQUIRED: Replace the content in this section with the technical details"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "  for the project. The structure here is presented in advisory capacity to guide"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "  the iteration process."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "--\u003e"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "**Language/Version**: [e.g., Python 3.11, Swift 5.9, Rust 1.75 or NEEDS CLARIFICATION]  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "**Primary Dependencies**: [e.g., FastAPI, UIKit, LLVM or NEEDS CLARIFICATION]  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "**Storage**: [if applicable, e.g., PostgreSQL, CoreData, files or N/A]  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "**Testing**: [e.g., pytest, XCTest, cargo test or NEEDS CLARIFICATION]  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "**Target Platform**: [e.g., Linux server, iOS 15+, WASM or NEEDS CLARIFICATION]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "**Project Type**: [e.g., library/cli/web-service/mobile-app/compiler/desktop-app or NEEDS CLARIFICATION]  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "**Performance Goals**: [domain-specific, e.g., 1000 req/s, 10k lines/sec, 60 fps or NEEDS CLARIFICATION]  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "**Constraints**: [domain-specific, e.g., \u003c200ms p95, \u003c100MB memory, offline-capable or NEEDS CLARIFICATION]  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "**Scale/Scope**: [domain-specific, e.g., 10k users, 1M LOC, 50 screens or NEEDS CLARIFICATION]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "## Constitution Check"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "Per &#96;.specify/memory/constitution.md&#96;:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "- **Clarity \u0026 simplicity**: The plan states the simplest approach that meets requirements;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "  any non-obvious simplicity tradeoff is noted for inline comments during implementation."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "- **Performance vs readability**: Technical Context lists performance goals/constraints;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "  designs do not assume readability alone overrides measurable performance without a"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "  documented tradeoff."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "- **Commenting**: Research/design identifies areas that will need explanatory comments"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "  (complex logic, algorithms, framework edge cases, concurrency, security-sensitive paths)."
          }
        ],

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "description: \"Task list template for feature implementation\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "# Tasks: [FEATURE NAME]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "**Input**: Design documents from &#96;/specs/[###-feature-name]/&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "**Prerequisites**: plan.md (required), spec.md (required for user stories), research.md, data-model.md, contracts/"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "**Tests**: The examples below include test tasks. Tests are OPTIONAL - only include them if explicitly requested in the feature specification."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story to enable independent implementation and testing of each story, and each task should represent a small, reviewable change unit."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "## Format: &#96;[ID] [P?] [Story] Description&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependencies)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "- **[Story]**: Which user story this task belongs to (e.g., US1, US2, US3)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "- Include exact file paths in descriptions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21,
            "text": "## Path Conventions"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "- **Single project**: &#96;src/&#96;, &#96;tests/&#96; at repository root"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "- **Web app**: &#96;backend/src/&#96;, &#96;frontend/src/&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "- **Mobile**: &#96;api/src/&#96;, &#96;ios/src/&#96; or &#96;android/src/&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "- Paths shown below assume single project - adjust based on plan.md structure"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "\u003c!-- "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "  ============================================================================"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "  IMPORTANT: The tasks below are SAMPLE TASKS for illustration purposes only."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "  The /speckit.tasks command MUST replace these with actual tasks based on:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "  - User stories from spec.md (with their priorities P1, P2, P3...)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "  - Feature requirements from plan.md"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "  - Entities from data-model.md"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "  - Endpoints from contracts/"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "  Tasks MUST be organized by user story so each story can be:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39,
            "text": "  - Implemented independently"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,

          },

            "text": "create policy \"organizations_select_member\""

          },

          },

            "text": "I'll create policies for each table - this gets long. Simplified MVP policies:"

          },

          },
```

Flow:
```typescript
const admin = createClient(url, serviceKey, { auth: { persistSession: false } });

// Create user via auth admin
const { data: userData, error } = await admin.auth.admin.createUser({
  email: `test-${Date.now()}@example.test`,
  password: 'test-password-12345',
  email_confirm: true,
});
const userId = userData.user!.id;

// Insert org
const { data: org, error: orgErr } = await admin.from('organizations').insert({
  slug: `test-org-${Date.now()}`,
  name: 'Test Org',
  created_by_user_id: userId,
}).select('id').single();

// Insert role_templates - need rows for admin, instructor, coach per unique (org, role)

  organization_id: org.id,
  role: 'admin',
  can_manage_activities: false,
  can_manage_enrollments: false,
  can_manage_staff: false,
  updated_by_user_id: userId,
});

// Toggle

  can_manage_activities: true,
  can_manage_staff: true,
  updated_by_user_id: userId,
}).eq('organization_id', org.id).eq('role', 'admin');

// Verify
const { data: row } = await admin.from('role_templates').select('*').eq('organization_id', org.id).eq('role', 'admin').single();
expect(row.can_manage_activities).toBe(true);
```

```typescript
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
const serviceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

const hasSupabaseIntegrationEnv = Boolean(url && serviceKey);

describe.skipIf(!hasSupabaseIntegrationEnv)(
  "US1 role template toggle behavior (Supabase)",
  () => {
    const supabase = createClient(url!, serviceKey!, {
      auth: { autoRefreshToken: false, persistSession: false },
    });

    let orgId: string;
    let ownerUserId: string;
    const testSlugPrefix = `rt-int-${Date.now()}`;

    beforeAll(async () => {
      const email = `${testSlugPrefix}@activiq.test`;
      const { data: created, error: userErr } =
        await supabase.auth.admin.createUser({
          email,
          password: "TestPassword123!@#",
          email_confirm: true,
        });
      if (userErr || !created.user) throw userErr ?? new Error("no user");
      ownerUserId = created.user.id;

      const slug = `${testSlugPrefix}-org`;
      const { data: org, error: orgErr } = await supabase
        .from("organizations")
        .insert({
          slug,
          name: "Integration Test Org",
          created_by_user_id: ownerUserId,
        })
        .select("id")
        .single();
      if (orgErr || !org) throw orgErr ?? new Error("no org");
      orgId = org.id;

      const { error: rtErr } = await supabase.from("role_templates").insert([
        {
          organization_id: orgId,
          role: "admin",
          can_manage_activities: false,
          can_manage_enrollments: false,
          can_manage_staff: false,
          updated_by_user_id: ownerUserId,
        },
        {
          organization_id: orgId,
          role: "instructor",
          can_manage_activities: false,
          can_manage_enrollments: false,
          can_manage_staff: false,
          updated_by_user_id: ownerUserId,
        },
      ]);
      if (rtErr) throw rtErr;
    });

    afterAll(async () => {
      if (orgId) {
        await supabase.from("organizations").delete().eq("id", orgId);
      }
      if (ownerUserId) {
        await supabase.auth.admin.deleteUser(ownerUserId);
      }
    });

    it("updates admin capability toggles and persists readable values", async () => {
      const { error: upErr } = await supabase
        .from("role_templates")
        .update({
          can_manage_activities: true,
          can_manage_enrollments: true,
          can_manage_staff: false,
          updated_by_user_id: ownerUserId,
        })
        .eq("organization_id", orgId)
        .eq("role", "admin");
      expect(upErr).toBeNull();

      const { data: row, error: selErr } = await supabase
        .from("role_templates")
        .select(
          "can_manage_activities, can_manage_enrollments, can_manage_staff",
        )
        .eq("organization_id", orgId)
        .eq("role", "admin")
        .single();
      expect(selErr).toBeNull();
      expect(row?.can_manage_activities).toBe(true);
      expect(row?.can_manage_enrollments).toBe(true);
      expect(row?.can_manage_staff).toBe(false);
    });

    it("keeps instructor template toggles independent from admin", async () => {
      await supabase
        .from("role_templates")
        .update({
          can_manage_staff: true,
          updated_by_user_id: ownerUserId,
        })
        .eq("organization_id", orgId)
        .eq("role", "instructor");

      const { data: adminRow } = await supabase
        .from("role_templates")
        .select("can_manage_staff")
        .eq("organization_id", orgId)
        .eq("role", "admin")
        .single();

      const { data: instRow } = await supabase
        .from("role_templates")
        .select("can_manage_staff")
        .eq("organization_id", orgId)
        .eq("role", "instructor")
        .single();

      expect(adminRow?.can_manage_staff).toBe(false);
      expect(instRow?.can_manage_staff).toBe(true);
    });
  },
);

describe("US1 role template integration prerequisites", () => {
  it("documents required env for DB-backed integration tests", () => {
    if (!hasSupabaseIntegrationEnv) {
      expect(
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL && process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY,
      ).toBeFalsy();
    } else {
      expect(hasSupabaseIntegrationEnv).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});
```
